title: LANG.DY.------STF.
description: Chart on book p. 308 (PR.S(RD)II-62). LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the subject; STF (source transfer) is the partner. From the subject: AFI (affinity insight), EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and MT-INFO (multi-information). From AFI: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: PRI-INFO (principle information). From EXP-DY: TH-CONT (thrust continuance). From TH-CONT: RT-ALGN (reality alignment) and SCI-DY (scientific dynamics). From SCI-DY: ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From MT-INFO: P-FC (particular focus). From P-FC: STY (style). A short line from the PRI-INFO line ends in a dot with no label.
